rules.rule_text: Qualifying evidence must be an independently attributable operating or test record tied to the named site with observation period, conditions, method, and responsible organization. An operator record can qualify only when its attributable methodology is present; dependency remains separately visible.

Qualifying evidence must identify an additional attributable operator or independently controlled site with a materially comparable deployed architecture and operating status. The ADDITIONAL_ENTITY_OR_SITE facet prevents the accepted baseline instance from qualifying as its own replication. An E4 operator-owned record may qualify; E5 is not a universal minimum.
